==Background==
{{Quote|I'm going to prove it, that I'm the main charcter of this story.|Author's comment}}
"'''Main Character'''" is an original rock song by *Luna featuring Kagamine Len, it was one of his notable songs and also their first work of using Len.

The song presents a bittersweet reflective narrative and themes about ambition, conviction, inevitable divergence of life paths, and the conflict between what is normal life vs. personal dreams.

The story follows a boy who is a pianist. has always viewed himself as the "main protagonist" of his own story. This is not born of arrogance, but from a steadfast belief in following what he perceives to be the "right" path, regardless of where it leads. In his youth, he shared a close bond with a friend who is a guitarist, With whom he dreamed of becoming musicians. Together, they were united by lofty ambitions and a shared determination to ''make something happen''.

As time passed, however, his friend chose a conventional, stable path into adulthood, leaving those musical dreams behind. Unwilling to follow suit, the boy rejected what he saw as an ordinary and uninspired future, choosing instead a more uncertain, arduous route in pursuit of something extraordinary. This decision left him isolated, facing setbacks, hardship, and a point of no return. Though no one openly predicted his failure, he felt the unspoken doubts surrounding him. Nevertheless, he remained resolute, believing that the role of a true protagonist demands persistence.

As the years unfolded, he recognized the widening gulf between himself and his former friend, their lives now existing in worlds too different for mutual understanding. While he does not regret the path he chose, he resents the pain it has brought and the impossibility of turning back, embodying the paradox of finding strength and purpose in a journey that is both empowering and profoundly isolating.

However, in the new version of the song with the "'''Remaster'''" subtitle, the added lyrics conclude with the boy's unwavering resolve to take full control of his own life, without compromise and without reliance on others. This shift reframes the narrative into one of absolute independence, where every choice, success, and failure rests entirely on his shoulders. In doing so, the song captures both the liberating sense of agency that comes with such freedom, and the inevitable solitude it brings, leaving the listener with a bittersweet reflection on what it truly means to live entirely for oneself.

This song has entered the ''[[Hall of Fame]]''.

The original version is featured in the album of the [[メインキャラクター (Main Character) (album)|same name]].

The remastered version is featured in the albums ''[[初音ミク「マジカルミライ 2019」OFFICIAL ALBUM (Hatsune Miku "Magical Mirai 2019" OFFICIAL ALBUM)|Hatsune Miku "Magical Mirai 2019" OFFICIAL ALBUM]]'' and ''[[KARENT presents 鏡音リン・レン 10th Anniversary -LODESTAR-]]''.

==Other media appearances==
===Discogrpahy===
The original version of this song was featured on the following albums:
*[[メインキャラクター (Main Character) (album)]]
*初音ミク「マジカルミライ 2019」Blu-ray＆DVD (Hatsune Miku "Magical Mirai 2019" Blu-ray＆DVD)
Omake Character is featured on the following album:
*春の魔法 - Magic of Youth - (Haru no Mahou - Magic of Youth -) 
A remastered version of this song was featured on the following album:
*鏡音リン・レン 10th Anniversary -LODESTAR- (Kagamine Rin Len 10th Anniversary -LODESTAR-)
*初音ミク「マジカルミライ 2019」OFFICIAL ALBUM (Hatsune Miku "Magical Mirai 2019" OFFICIAL ALBUM)
*Traverse
An another remastered version of this song was featured on the following album:
*Nobody

===Concerts===
The remastered version was featured in the following concerts:
* [[Hatsune Miku Magical Mirai 2019|Magical Mirai 2019]]
* [[MIKU WITH YOU 2019]]
* [[Kagamine Rin & Len Happy 14th Birthday Party 「Two You☆★」]]

===Video games===
This song was featured in the video game ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}''.
